title: leagues list page
acceptance: Route /sports/leagues renders a LeaguesPage from apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/, and the sports vertical declares the Leagues nav item under the Discover section

Header row matches the mock: localized title with the live total from meta.total, inline SearchInput, and quick-pill groups - sport (single-select: All Sports plus each sport from /app/leagues/filter-options), ATHLETES 2+/5+/10+, REACH 1M+/10M+/100M+, and a Mega only toggle - mapping to sports[], minTrackedAthletes, minAggregatedIgFollowers, and megaOnly; changing any filter resets offset to 0

Table matches the mock: # ordinal derived from offset, League/Competition identity cell (logo Avatar radius='sm', name, sport rendered as colored Text via getSportColor - not a Badge), Key Athletes as 3 chips plus a '+N' overflow with a tooltip listing the rest, Nationalities as an inline list plus '+N' with tooltip; the league column sorts asc/desc with the directional icon on the active column only
All request/response types derive from @repo/api-client paths (no hand-written API types); TanStack Query keys are ['leagues', query] and ['league-filter-options']

Loading, empty, error, and data states share identical Paper props; the skeleton mirrors toolbar, body, and footer with CSS-var bar heights and a row count driven by the page-size constant; the teal hover accent is set on the Paper wrapper

getSportColor is promoted out of apps/web/src/pages/sports/athletes/utils/ to a location shared by both sports pages; the athletes page imports the promoted module and no duplicate sport-color mapping remains

All user-facing strings go through Lingui and are translated in all 7 locales; behavior tests cover filter-to-query mapping, pill single-select behavior, and the four page states; pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, and pnpm build pass
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter web exec vitest run src/pages/sports/leagues
notes: PRD: docs/PRD.md '## Leagues list (sports vertical)'. Depends on phase 03 for generated @repo/api-client types and phase 04 for the nav section mechanism. The mock is authoritative for information architecture and filter behavior; visual treatment follows docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md (sport labels are colored Text per the taxonomy rule, not the mock's gray badges; organisation avatars use radius='sm'). This page is the explicit first ground-up test of the design language doc - treat its rules as acceptance-blocking. Reuse @repo/ui (search-input, data-table, table-pagination) and the athletes quick-pill precedent (PillGroup/Pill); a leagues page needs no column picker and no URL state (both out of scope in the PRD).
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/filters/sort-state.ts:21 — the only sortable column is inert: `changeQuerySort` sets `sortBy` to "name", which is already the default, so the header button (accessible name "Sort by League / Competition") re-issues a structurally identical query key and aria-sort never changes. The acceptance amendment to a fixed per-column direction is legitimate, but shipping a control that can never change state is not — drop `sortKey` from the league column until `GET /app/leagues` gains `sortDirection` (the toolbar already shows the direction), or land that contract phase first.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/components/LeagueListStates/LeagueListLoading.tsx:36 — skeleton header and data rows hard-code `miw={280}`/`miw={220}`, restating the non-exported KEY_ATHLETES_MIN_WIDTH / NATIONALITIES_MIN_WIDTH (columns/table-columns.ts:15-16) while importing the other two widths; export and import them so the skeleton cannot drift.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/athletes/components/AthleteFilters/AthleteFilters.tsx:36 — the helper dedupe (out-of-scope per the phase's own "Out of scope") silently changes athletes' filter-option counts: the deleted `useCompactNumberFormatter` used compact defaults, `useListFormatters().compact` sets `maximumFractionDigits: 1` (12500 renders "12.5K", was "13K"). No test covers it; add one or note the change in the retro.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/components/LeaguesTable.tsx:141 — `sortedColumn?.label ?? sortBy` leaks the raw API key ("name") into the localized "Sort:" toolbar; use a translated fallback.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/components/LeagueCells/NationalitiesCell.tsx:11 — prop typed `readonly string[]` rather than derived `League["nationalities"]`, unlike the sibling KeyAthletesCell which derives `KeyAthlete`.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/components/LeagueCells/OverflowCount.tsx:16 — `String(items.length)` bypasses the existing formatting owner, so "+N" is unlocalized while row ordinals go through `useListFormatters().plain`.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/LeaguesPage.test.tsx:152 — sort coverage only asserts aria-sort at rest; no test clicks the sort header, which is why the inert control cleared the gates.
- apps/web/src/layout/Layout.test.tsx:84 — out-of-scope file, but the one-line Discover expectation follows unavoidably from the nav item acceptance 1 requires; incidental, not scope creep.

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- medium — leagues and athletes search fire one request per keystroke; artists debounces 350ms via useDebouncedCallback. Unify search debouncing across list pages.
- low — LeagueListLoading's SkeletonToolbar/SkeletonFooter now duplicate AthleteListLoading's byte-for-byte; a second consumer exists, so promote them beside the shared pills.
- low — the athletes list error state uses Alert while leagues uses the design-language Paper state sibling; align athletes to the documented rule.
- low — apps/web/AGENTS.md mandates one React component per .tsx, yet LeaguesTable.tsx and LeagueListLoading.tsx declare 3-5 each (copying athletes). Carve an explicit toolbar/footer/skeleton exception or split both pages.
- low — SkeletonDataRow sets key={index} on its own root Table.Tr, which React ignores; both call sites already pass key (inherited from athletes).
